We will investigate this matter further and will provide you with a response as soon as possible.

We will also review the account history and verify the information provided to us. The current balance on this account is $2,903.41. The original creditor is Liberty Credit Corp, and the charge-off date is June 3, 2023. Your last payment was received on November 19, 2024.

Please be advised that under Massachusetts state law, you have the right to dispute this debt and request validation. We will provide you with a response as soon as possible. If we determine that the debt is valid, we will continue to attempt to collect the debt in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

If you have any further questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to contact us. You may also continue to dispute this debt if you believe it is not valid.

Sincerely,
